blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Water: Complete Training Edition (Part 3)

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives — Part C
blocks.en: Learning Objectives — Part C

blocks.zh: 理解製程控制（PC）取樣與品質控制（QC）取樣的目的差異及方法要求
blocks.en: Understand the differences in purpose and method requirements between process control (PC) sampling and quality control (QC) sampling

blocks.zh: 了解水系統驗證取樣計畫（Validation Sampling Plan）的三階段策略
blocks.en: Know the three-phase strategy of the water system validation sampling plan

blocks.zh: 掌握製藥水系統中常見微生物的種類（革蘭氏陰性菌、biofilm 形成菌）及其控制
blocks.en: Know the common microorganisms in pharmaceutical water systems (Gram-negative bacteria, biofilm formers) and how to control them

blocks.zh: 理解 Biofilm 的形成機制（EPS matrix、quorum sensing）及對水系統的影響
blocks.en: Understand the mechanism of biofilm formation (EPS matrix, quorum sensing) and its effect on water systems

blocks.zh: 了解細菌內毒素（endotoxin/LPS）的來源、特性及在水系統中的控制方法
blocks.en: Know the sources and characteristics of bacterial endotoxin (endotoxin/LPS) and how to control it in water systems

blocks.zh: 掌握 Alert Level、Action Level 和 Specification 三層控制架構的定義與設定邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the definitions and setting logic of the three-tier control structure: Alert Level, Action Level, and Specification

blocks.zh: 了解微生物測試方法（古典培養法、快速微生物方法 RMM）的選擇原則
blocks.en: Know the principles for choosing microbial test methods (classical culture methods versus rapid microbiological methods, RMM)

blocks.zh: Section 6 — Sampling 取樣
blocks.en: Section 6 — Sampling

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — PC vs QC 取樣的根本差異
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Fundamental Difference Between PC and QC Sampling

blocks.zh: 水系統取樣有兩個截然不同的目的：
blocks.en: Water system sampling has two quite different purposes:

blocks.zh: PC 取樣（製程控制）：了解系統內部狀況，目的是「調整系統」。取樣點在閥門後方（inside the system），避免外部污染，反映真實水質
blocks.en: PC sampling (process control): to understand the condition inside the system, with the aim of "adjusting the system". The sampling point is downstream of the valve (inside the system), which avoids external contamination and reflects the true water quality

blocks.zh: QC 取樣（品質控制）：確認用於生產的水是否合格，目的是「放行決策」。取樣點在使用點，模擬實際用水情境
blocks.en: QC sampling (quality control): to confirm whether the water used in production is acceptable, with the aim of a "release decision". The sampling point is at the point of use, simulating the actual way the water is used

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：同一個取樣點的數據，有時可以同時用於 PC 和 QC，但取樣方法和判讀標準必須事先定義清楚。
blocks.en: Key principle: data from the same sampling point can sometimes serve both PC and QC, but the sampling method and the criteria for interpretation must be clearly defined in advance.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 化學 vs 微生物屬性的均勻性差異
blocks.en: Key Notes — Uniformity of Chemical vs Microbial Attributes

blocks.zh: 這是 USP 〈1231〉 中一個非常重要的概念：化學屬性（導電度、TOC）在整個系統中相對均勻，因此可以在循環回路的關鍵點用在線儀器代表全系統的化學品質。但微生物屬性非常不均勻——不同管路位置可能因 biofilm 發育程度不同而有顯著差異。因此，微生物監控必須覆蓋所有使用點，不能像化學監控一樣「選代表點」。
blocks.en: This is a very important concept in USP <1231>: chemical attributes (conductivity, TOC) are relatively uniform throughout the system, so online instruments at key points in the recirculation loop can represent the chemical quality of the whole system. Microbial attributes, however, are highly non-uniform: different pipe locations can differ significantly depending on how far biofilm has developed. Microbial monitoring must therefore cover all points of use, and you cannot "choose representative points" as you can for chemical monitoring.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 微生物的不均勻性
blocks.en: Analogy — The Non-Uniformity of Microorganisms

blocks.zh: 水系統的微生物分佈就像城市的「食物攤販」——某些角落（dead legs、低流速處）可能聚集了很多攤販（biofilm），而其他地方（高流速主管）幾乎沒有。如果只在「中央廣場」取樣（循環回路回水端），你永遠發現不了「偏僻角落」的污染。這就是為什麼所有使用點都需要定期取樣。
blocks.en: The microbial distribution in a water system is like "food stalls" in a city: certain corners (dead legs, low-flow areas) may gather many stalls (biofilm), while other places (high-flow main lines) have almost none. If you sample only at the "central square" (the return end of the recirculation loop), you will never find the contamination in the "remote corners". This is why all points of use need to be sampled regularly.

blocks.zh: 水系統取樣計畫框架 Sampling Plan Framework
blocks.en: Sampling Plan Framework

blocks.zh:
取樣類型        頻率建議          測試項目
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
PC 在線監控     連續（24/7）      導電度、TOC、溫度、流量
PC 離線         每日或每週        微生物（PW）/ 每日（WFI）
QC 放行         每批或每日        導電度、TOC、微生物、Endotoxin（WFI）
原水監控         每季或供應商報告   全飲用水標準測試
PQ Phase 1      每日所有點        全項目（2–4 週）
PQ Phase 3      依風險輪流        縮減但仍覆蓋所有點（1 年）
blocks.en:
Sampling type     Recommended frequency   Tests
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
PC online         Continuous (24/7)       Conductivity, TOC, temperature, flow
PC offline        Daily or weekly         Microbial (PW) / daily (WFI)
QC release        Each batch or daily     Conductivity, TOC, microbial, endotoxin (WFI)
Source water      Quarterly or supplier   Full drinking water standard tests
  monitoring      report
PQ Phase 1        Daily, all points       All parameters (2–4 weeks)
PQ Phase 3        Rotating, risk-based    Reduced but still covering all points (1 year)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 無菌填充廠，WFI 系統的取樣計畫通常包含：每日在線導電度/TOC 自動記錄、每週在所有使用點取樣做微生物計數、每月在關鍵點取樣做 endotoxin 測試。FDA 查廠時特別關注：(1) 是否有使用點長期未取樣（輪換取樣計畫必須合理）；(2) 取樣程序 SOP 是否有充分的衝洗步驟；(3) 微生物陽性結果的調查是否追溯到根本原因。
blocks.en: At a CDMO sterile filling plant, the sampling plan for a WFI system usually includes: daily automatic recording of online conductivity/TOC, weekly sampling at all points of use for microbial counts, and monthly sampling at key points for endotoxin testing. FDA inspectors pay particular attention to: (1) whether any point of use has gone unsampled for a long time (the rotating sampling plan must be justified); (2) whether the sampling SOP has an adequate flushing step; (3) whether the investigation of positive microbial results is traced back to the root cause.

blocks.zh: Section 8 — Microbial Evaluations 微生物評估
blocks.en: Section 8 — Microbial Evaluations

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 水系統微生物生態學
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Microbial Ecology of Water Systems

blocks.zh: 製藥水系統中最重要的微生物學概念：
blocks.en: The most important microbiology concepts for pharmaceutical water systems:

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性菌是主要威脅：適合在水中生存，能形成 biofilm，且含有 endotoxin（LPS）
blocks.en: Gram-negative bacteria are the main threat: they survive well in water, can form biofilm, and contain endotoxin (LPS)

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陽性菌：通常是污染指標（取樣技術問題），不是水系統的原住民
blocks.en: Gram-positive bacteria: usually an indicator of contamination (a sampling technique problem) and not native to the water system

blocks.zh: Pseudomonads 是最常見的水系統菌：Pseudomonas、Ralstonia 等是已適應純水環境的「oligotroph（寡養型微生物）」
blocks.en: Pseudomonads are the most common water system organisms: Pseudomonas, Ralstonia, and others are "oligotrophs" adapted to the purified water environment

blocks.zh: Biofilm 的生命週期與控制策略
blocks.en: The Biofilm Lifecycle and Control Strategy

blocks.zh: Biofilm 形成的四個階段：
blocks.en: The four stages of biofilm formation:

blocks.zh: 初始黏附（Reversible Attachment）：浮游菌接觸管壁表面
blocks.en: Initial attachment (Reversible Attachment): planktonic bacteria make contact with the pipe wall surface

blocks.zh: 不可逆黏附（Irreversible Attachment）：細菌開始分泌 EPS
blocks.en: Irreversible Attachment: the bacteria begin to secrete EPS

blocks.zh: 成熟 Biofilm：三維立體結構，Quorum Sensing 協調，極難殺滅
blocks.en: Mature Biofilm: a three-dimensional structure coordinated by Quorum Sensing, extremely difficult to kill

blocks.zh: 分散（Dispersion）：釋放「先驅細胞」（pioneer cells）到水流中，繼續擴散
blocks.en: Dispersion: "pioneer cells" are released into the water flow and continue to spread

blocks.zh: 控制策略：在 Stage 2（不可逆黏附）之前介入最有效——高流速、定期消毒、無死角設計。
blocks.en: Control strategy: intervention before Stage 2 (irreversible attachment) is the most effective: high flow velocity, regular sanitization, and a design without dead legs.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — Endotoxin 的特殊性
blocks.en: Key Notes — What Makes Endotoxin Special

blocks.zh: 理解內毒素（Endotoxin/LPS）的幾個關鍵特性：
blocks.en: Key characteristics of endotoxin (Endotoxin/LPS) to understand:

blocks.zh: 耐熱性強：普通 121°C 高壓蒸汽滅菌無法破壞 endotoxin（需 250°C 乾熱 30 min 或 180°C 2–4 h）
blocks.en: Highly heat-resistant: ordinary 121°C autoclaving cannot destroy endotoxin (it takes 250°C dry heat for 30 min or 180°C for 2–4 h)

blocks.zh: 消毒不等於去除：殺死細菌後，endotoxin 仍留在水中（甚至增加，因為細菌裂解釋放 LPS）
blocks.en: Sanitization is not removal: after the bacteria are killed, the endotoxin remains in the water (and may even increase, because lysis of the bacteria releases LPS)

blocks.zh: 蒸餾是最佳去除方式：endotoxin 分子量大（分子量 >1000 Da），不會蒸發到蒸汽中，蒸餾可有效去除（3–4 log）
blocks.en: Distillation is the best removal method: endotoxin has a large molecular weight (>1000 Da) and does not evaporate into the steam, so distillation removes it effectively (3–4 log)

blocks.zh: 膜過濾的限制：0.2 µm 過濾器不能去除 endotoxin（因為 endotoxin 聚集成膠束，大小不一定），UF（10 kDa）才能有效截留
blocks.en: Limitation of membrane filtration: a 0.2 µm filter cannot remove endotoxin (because endotoxin aggregates into micelles of variable size); only UF (10 kDa) retains it effectively

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — Biofilm 的 Quorum Sensing
blocks.en: Analogy — Quorum Sensing in Biofilm

blocks.zh: Biofilm 的 Quorum Sensing 就像細菌的「人口計數」系統——每個細菌持續分泌微量的「信號分子」，當這些分子累積到足夠濃度（表示「人口夠多了」），所有細菌同時啟動 biofilm 基因程式，開始大量製造 EPS 保護層。這就像一個城市等到足夠人口才開始建設「城牆」（EPS）——一旦城牆建好，外來的消毒劑就很難滲入。這解釋了為什麼「早期介入」（在 biofilm 成熟前消毒）遠比「事後補救」更有效。
blocks.en: Quorum Sensing in biofilm is like the bacteria's "population count" system: each bacterium continuously secretes tiny amounts of a "signal molecule", and when these molecules accumulate to a sufficient concentration (meaning "the population is large enough"), all the bacteria switch on the biofilm gene program at the same time and begin to produce large amounts of the EPS protective layer. It is like a city that starts building "city walls" (EPS) only once it has enough people: once the walls are built, it is hard for outside sanitizing agents to penetrate. This explains why "early intervention" (sanitizing before the biofilm matures) is far more effective than "remediation after the fact".

blocks.zh: 微生物測試方法比較 Microbial Test Method Comparison
blocks.en: Microbial Test Method Comparison

MPN               可半定量           精度低             特殊情況
ATP 螢光           超快速（分鐘）    需驗證相關性         RMM 選項
16S rDNA 定序     鑑定到種           成本高              調查用
blocks.en:
Method            Advantages          Disadvantages        Use
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Membrane Filter   Large sample        Many steps           Required for WFI
                  (200 mL)
MPN               Semi-quantitative   Low precision        Special cases

                  (minutes)           validated

                  species level

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 微生物測試的培養基選擇
blocks.en: Key Notes — Choice of Culture Medium for Microbial Testing

blocks.zh: USP 建議 PW 和 WFI 都使用 Plate Count Agar（PCA/TGYA），培養條件 30–35°C，48–72 小時。雖然低營養培養基（如 R2A）對飲用水有優勢，但對高純度製藥水（很低營養環境），PCA 和 R2A 的計數差異通常很小。重要：更換培養基需要進行比較研究（comparative media analysis），不能直接替換。
blocks.en: USP recommends Plate Count Agar (PCA/TGYA) for both PW and WFI, incubated at 30–35°C for 48–72 hours. Although low-nutrient media (such as R2A) have advantages for drinking water, for high-purity pharmaceutical water (a very low-nutrient environment) the difference in counts between PCA and R2A is usually small. Important: a change of culture medium requires a comparative study (comparative media analysis); the medium cannot simply be replaced.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 水系統取樣發現革蘭氏陽性菌（如 Staphylococcus），這是否代表水系統有問題？應如何調查？
blocks.en: Gram-positive bacteria (such as Staphylococcus) are found when sampling a water system. Does this mean there is a problem with the water system? How should it be investigated?

blocks.zh: WFI 系統消毒（thermal sanitization）後 24 小時取樣，endotoxin 結果反而比消毒前升高，這是正常的嗎？原因是什麼？
blocks.en: Endotoxin results taken 24 hours after thermal sanitization of a WFI system are higher than before sanitization. Is this normal? What is the reason?

blocks.zh: 公司計畫引入 ATP bioluminescence 作為微生物快速測試方法，需要進行哪些驗證才能支持 GMP 使用？
blocks.en: The company plans to introduce ATP bioluminescence as a rapid microbial test method. What validation is needed to support its use in GMP?

blocks.zh: Section 9 — Alert and Action Levels and Specifications 警示與行動標準
blocks.en: Section 9 — Alert and Action Levels and Specifications

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts — 三層控制架構
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Three-Tier Control Structure

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 推薦的三層水系統控制架構：
blocks.en: The three-tier control structure for water systems recommended by USP <1231>:

blocks.zh: Alert Level（警示標準）：「黃燈」。超過時啟動調查，但水仍可使用。Alert Level 從歷史正常範圍的「邊緣」設定——通常設在正常數據的 95th percentile 附近。
blocks.en: Alert Level: the "yellow light". When exceeded, an investigation is started, but the water can still be used. The Alert Level is set at the "edge" of the historical normal range, usually near the 95th percentile of the normal data.

blocks.zh: Action Level（行動標準）：「紅燈」。超過時必須立即採取行動（增加監控、消毒、停用等）。
blocks.en: Action Level: the "red light". When exceeded, action must be taken immediately (increased monitoring, sanitization, taking the system out of use, etc.).

blocks.zh: Specification（規格限度）：藥典或法規規定的絕對限度（如 PW microbial limit = 100 cfu/mL）。超標即為 OOS，需正式調查和產品影響評估。
blocks.en: Specification: the absolute limit set by the pharmacopeia or regulation (for example, PW microbial limit = 100 cfu/mL). Exceeding it is an OOS, requiring a formal investigation and product impact assessment.

blocks.zh: 典型製藥水微生物限度 Typical Microbial Limits
blocks.en: Typical Microbial Limits for Pharmaceutical Water

blocks.zh:
水的種類             Alert Level    Action Level    Specification
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Purified Water       <10 cfu/mL    <50 cfu/mL     ≤100 cfu/mL
Water for Injection  <1 cfu/100mL  <5 cfu/100mL   ≤10 cfu/100mL
原水（Source Water）  –             –              ≤500 cfu/mL

注：Alert/Action Level 由各廠根據歷史數據自行設定，
    上表為常見的工業標準參考值，非法規強制規定

Endotoxin：
Water for Injection     Specification ≤0.25 EU/mL
Water for Hemodialysis  Specification ≤1.0 EU/mL
blocks.en:
Water type            Alert Level    Action Level    Specification
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Purified Water        <10 cfu/mL    <50 cfu/mL     ≤100 cfu/mL
Water for Injection   <1 cfu/100mL  <5 cfu/100mL   ≤10 cfu/100mL
Source Water          –              –              ≤500 cfu/mL

Note: Alert/Action Levels are set by each plant based on historical data;
      the table above gives commonly used industry reference values
      and is not a regulatory requirement

Endotoxin:
Water for Injection     Specification ≤0.25 EU/mL
Water for Hemodialysis  Specification ≤1.0 EU/mL

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — 三層標準的比喻
blocks.en: Analogy — A Metaphor for the Three Tiers

blocks.zh: 可以用「交通燈系統」比喻三層控制架構：
blocks.en: The three-tier control structure can be compared to a "traffic light system":

blocks.zh: Alert Level = 「黃燈」：放慢速度，準備應對，但可以繼續前進
blocks.en: Alert Level = "yellow light": slow down and get ready to respond, but you can keep going

blocks.zh: Action Level = 「紅燈」：必須停下來採取行動，不能假裝沒看到
blocks.en: Action Level = "red light": you must stop and take action; you cannot pretend you did not see it

blocks.zh: Specification = 「交通事故」：已經發生問題，需要全面調查和善後
blocks.en: Specification = "traffic accident": a problem has already occurred, requiring a full investigation and clean-up

blocks.zh: Alert Level 的價值在於提供「預警時間」——在真正超標（Specification）之前就採取行動，防止問題惡化。
blocks.en: The value of the Alert Level is that it provides "early warning time": action is taken before the Specification is actually exceeded, preventing the problem from getting worse.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — OOS 水的影響評估
blocks.en: Key Notes — Impact Assessment of OOS Water

blocks.zh: 水系統 OOS 事件的調查是最複雜的 QC 調查之一，因為水被用於多個批次和多種製程。調查必須回答：哪些產品批次可能受影響？受影響的程度如何？受影響批次的處置方式？影響評估需要跨部門協作（QC + QA + 生產），並可能需要通知客戶（CDMO 情況）或監管機構（重大偏差）。
blocks.en: The investigation of a water system OOS event is one of the most complex QC investigations, because the water is used for multiple batches and multiple processes. The investigation must answer: which product batches may be affected? How seriously? How should the affected batches be dispositioned? The impact assessment requires cross-functional collaboration (QC + QA + Production), and may require notifying customers (in the CDMO situation) or the regulatory authority (major deviation).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes — 新系統的 Alert/Action Level 設定
blocks.en: Key Notes — Setting Alert/Action Levels for a New System

blocks.zh: 新水系統剛啟動時（前 12 個月），微生物計數往往呈現「成熟化趨勢」——從初始的極低計數，逐漸建立穩定的 microbiome。因此，新系統的 Alert Level 不應以系統第一個月的完美數據為基礎，否則在系統成熟後會造成大量誤報（false alert）。建議：Phase 1/2 PQ 完成後，基於第一年的完整數據重新調整 Alert/Action Level，並記錄在 Annual Review 中。
blocks.en: When a new water system has just started up (the first 12 months), the microbial counts often show a "maturation trend": from very low initial counts, a stable microbiome gradually becomes established. The Alert Level for a new system should therefore not be based on the perfect data of the first month, or it will cause many false alerts once the system matures. Recommendation: after Phase 1/2 PQ is complete, readjust the Alert/Action Levels based on the full first-year data and document this in the Annual Review.

blocks.zh: WFI 系統連續三個取樣點的微生物計數超過 Action Level，但尚未達到 Specification，這個情況需要停止使用 WFI 嗎？應如何決策？
blocks.en: Microbial counts at three consecutive sampling points of a WFI system exceed the Action Level but have not reached the Specification. Does the WFI need to be taken out of use? How should the decision be made?

blocks.zh: 一個使用了 5 年的 PW 系統，Alert Level 設定為 20 cfu/mL，但最近 6 個月幾乎所有數據都在 10–18 cfu/mL 之間波動。這個 Alert Level 設定是否合理？
blocks.en: For a PW system that has been in use for 5 years, the Alert Level is set at 20 cfu/mL, but over the last 6 months almost all the data have fluctuated between 10 and 18 cfu/mL. Is this Alert Level setting reasonable?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的水系統管理中，客戶稽核（customer audit）和 FDA 查廠時，審查員最常問的問題包括：(1) Alert Level 和 Action Level 是如何建立的？有歷史數據支撐嗎？(2) 過去 12 個月內有多少次 Alert Level 超標？每次的調查結論是什麼？(3) 最近的水系統年度回顧（Annual Review）結論是什麼？是否有趨勢值得關注？準備好這三個問題的書面答案，可以讓稽核過程更順暢。
blocks.en: In water system management at a CDMO, the questions that auditors most often ask during customer audits and FDA inspections include: (1) How were the Alert Level and Action Level established? Are they supported by historical data? (2) How many Alert Level excursions occurred in the past 12 months? What was the conclusion of each investigation? (3) What were the conclusions of the most recent water system Annual Review? Are there trends worth watching? Having written answers to these three questions ready makes the audit run more smoothly.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section C Summary
blocks.en: Section C Summary

blocks.zh: PC 取樣目的是了解系統狀況（調整系統），QC 取樣目的是放行決策；化學屬性均勻可用在線點代表，微生物屬性不均勻必須覆蓋所有使用點
blocks.en: The purpose of PC sampling is to understand the condition of the system (to adjust the system), and the purpose of QC sampling is the release decision; chemical attributes are uniform and can be represented by online points, while microbial attributes are non-uniform and must be covered at all points of use

blocks.zh: WFI 微生物取樣：必須使用膜過濾法（200 mL），PW 可用平板法（1 mL）或膜過濾法；Plate Count Agar，30–35°C，48–72 h
blocks.en: WFI microbial sampling: membrane filtration (200 mL) must be used; PW may use the plate method (1 mL) or membrane filtration; Plate Count Agar, 30–35°C, 48–72 h

blocks.zh: 水系統微生物以革蘭氏陰性菌為主（Pseudomonas、Ralstonia 等），革蘭氏陽性菌通常代表取樣污染
blocks.en: Water system microorganisms are mainly Gram-negative bacteria (Pseudomonas, Ralstonia, etc.); Gram-positive bacteria usually indicate sampling contamination

blocks.zh: Biofilm 的 EPS matrix 賦予極強的消毒抵抗力；Quorum Sensing 協調 biofilm 形成與分散；控制關鍵在於早期介入（成熟前消毒）
blocks.en: The EPS matrix of biofilm gives it very strong resistance to sanitization; Quorum Sensing coordinates biofilm formation and dispersion; the key to control is early intervention (sanitizing before maturation)

blocks.zh: Endotoxin（LPS）：耐熱，消毒不去除，蒸餾是最佳去除方式（3–4 log）；0.2 µm 過濾器無法去除，需 UF 或蒸餾
blocks.en: Endotoxin (LPS): heat-resistant, not removed by sanitization, best removed by distillation (3–4 log); a 0.2 µm filter cannot remove it, and UF or distillation is needed

blocks.zh: 三層控制架構：Alert Level（黃燈，調查）→ Action Level（紅燈，立即行動）→ Specification（OOS，正式調查 + 影響評估）
blocks.en: Three-tier control structure: Alert Level (yellow light, investigate) → Action Level (red light, act immediately) → Specification (OOS, formal investigation + impact assessment)

blocks.zh: 典型限度：PW 微生物 ≤100 cfu/mL；WFI 微生物 ≤10 cfu/100 mL；WFI Endotoxin ≤0.25 EU/mL；原水 Action Level 500 cfu/mL
blocks.en: Typical limits: PW microbial ≤100 cfu/mL; WFI microbial ≤10 cfu/100 mL; WFI endotoxin ≤0.25 EU/mL; source water Action Level 500 cfu/mL

blocks.zh: 快速微生物方法（RMM）需通過 USP 〈1223〉 方法驗證才能用於 GMP 決策；ATP 螢光、16S 定序是常見選項
blocks.en: Rapid microbiological methods (RMM) must pass method validation per USP <1223> before being used for GMP decisions; ATP fluorescence and 16S sequencing are common options

blocks.zh: 新系統的 Alert/Action Level 應在第一年數據成熟後重新校準；年度回顧必須記錄趨勢分析和調整依據
blocks.en: Alert/Action Levels for a new system should be recalibrated once the first year of data has matured; the annual review must document the trend analysis and the basis for adjustments

blocks.zh: USP 〈1231〉 完整章節總結 Full Chapter Final Summary
blocks.en: Full Chapter Final Summary — USP <1231>

blocks.zh: 第一部分（Part A）：水的分類體系（Bulk/Sterile/Non-Monographed）；Source Water 飲用水基準；各類水（PW/WFI/WFH/Pure Steam/Sterile Waters）的定義、用途和關鍵差異
blocks.en: Part A: the water classification system (Bulk/Sterile/Non-Monographed); the source water drinking water baseline; the definitions, uses, and key differences of each water (PW/WFI/WFH/Pure Steam/Sterile Waters)

blocks.zh: 第二部分（Part B）：驗證生命週期（DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ 三階段）；變更控制和週期性回顧；單元操作（RO/DI/蒸餾/UV/儲槽）；消毒方式（熱/化學/UV）；TOC + 導電度三段測試
blocks.en: Part B: the validation lifecycle (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ in three phases); change control and periodic review; unit operations (RO/DI/distillation/UV/storage tank); sanitization methods (heat/chemical/UV); TOC + three-stage conductivity test

blocks.zh: 第三部分（Part C）：PC vs QC 取樣設計；化學屬性均勻性 vs 微生物屬性不均勻性；Biofilm 機制與控制；Endotoxin 特性與去除；三層控制架構（Alert/Action/Specification）
blocks.en: Part C: PC vs QC sampling design; uniformity of chemical attributes vs non-uniformity of microbial attributes; biofilm mechanisms and control; endotoxin characteristics and removal; the three-tier control structure (Alert/Action/Specification)

blocks.zh: 核心監管理念：水系統管理是一個持續性、基於風險、以數據驅動的 GMP 活動，不是一次性驗證後就完成的工作
blocks.en: Core regulatory philosophy: water system management is a continuous, risk-based, data-driven GMP activity, not a task that is finished after a one-time validation
